caption: Realistic contemporary floor lamp with a clearly readable modular structure.
description: Realistic contemporary floor lamp with a clearly readable modular structure. The lamp must contain: - a stable circular or rectangular base - one long vertical stem - a clearly separated lampshade - a visible bulb or emitter element inside the shade - a few simple connection pieces between the stem and shade Elegant modern restaurant or interior design style. Realistic dimensions and manufacturable construction. Medium detail, clean geometry and clearly separated structural components. Single isolated floor lamp only. No table, no furniture, no room, no wall, no floor scene, no decorative clutter. Avoid extremely thin wires, excessive ornaments and floating pieces. Game-ready realistic 3D asset.
